name: capsaicin + levomenthol
purpose: Uses For the temporary relief of minor aches and pains of muscles and joints associated with: • Arthritis • Simple backache • Sprains • Bruises • Strains Purpose
uses: Uses For the temporary relief of minor aches and pains of muscles and joints associated with: • Arthritis • Simple backache • Sprains • Bruises • Strains Uses
otcwarn: Warnings For external use only. When using this product • Avoid contact with eyes • Do not apply to open wounds or damaged skin • Avoid using under tight bandages. Stop use and consult a physician if symptoms persist for more than 7 days. If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a healthcare professional before use. Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help immediately. Do Not Use Warnings For external use only.
